integrity: Source-based mathematical result with explicit assumptions, proof, runnable finite checker and exact-rational moment verifier; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed Hamming weight two; no claim for other weights or unconstrained random words.
The limiting CDF is given through a Dirichlet pushforward, not a closed elementary CDF.
Historical priority is qualified by possible unindexed equivalent results.
The deterministic five-run sharp coefficient and parity-strip count were already known and are not claimed as new.
title: A nondegenerate Abelian-square factor-count law for binary words with two ones
